title: Gucci Princy Boston
subtitle: Guccissima leather, made in Italy, late 2000s
details: Guccissima (embossed GG) leather, light taupe with a soft sheen
Fair to good, with visible wear

examined.title: Serial tag
examined.text: The leather tag inside reads “161720 / 002058”: style number 161720 (Princy Boston) above supplier and control code 002058, in the two-row format Gucci used at the time. Gucci numbers identify the model and supplier, not the individual bag, and carry no production date.

examined.title: Embossing and labels
examined.text: The Guccissima GG pattern is evenly spaced and aligned across the panels. The interior leather patch reads “GUCCI made in Italy” in clean, even lettering.

examined.title: Stitching
examined.text: Even topstitching on the handles, zip-pull tabs and base panels, with a consistent stitch length.

examined.title: Hardware
examined.text: Square zip pulls engraved with the Gucci script logo, and the Princy bow with pyramid-tipped ends and grommets. The gold-tone finish is consistent throughout.

examined.title: Lining
examined.text: Cream cotton twill with a burgundy and green horsebit print and a zip pocket, as used on the Princy line.

examined.title: Construction
examined.text: Shape, base corner panels and handle attachments are consistent with the model.

condition: Uneven toning and greyish marks on the front panel.
Darkening on the handles and along the edges.
Worn edge paint on the piping.
A small green mark on one zip-pull tab.
Light surface scratches on the hardware.
The lining is clean. No tears or open seams observed.
